verdict.rationale: The OpenAI Agents SDK is a developer library of primitives (agents, Runner, tools, handoffs) for building your own agents. It has no end-user product surface that could host a built-in assistant, so asking for one is a category error for this kind of product. Handoffs are delegation between agents that developers build themselves, not a built-in assistant users hand tasks to, so they don't make this axis apply.
